articles.summary: LYNNWOOD, Wash. , Nov. 20, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Zumiez Inc. (NASDAQ: ZUMZ) today announced it will report fiscal 2025 third quarter results on Thursday, December 4, 2025 , following the closing of regular stock market trading hours. The Company will hold a conference call that day at 5:00 p.m.
articles.title: Zumiez Inc. to Report Fiscal 2025 Third Quarter Results
